clues.text: Jubal, a son of Lamech, was called the father of all who play this and the flute.
When a spirit of distress tormented King Saul, young David would play this, and Saul found relief.
While David played this for King Saul, the jealous king hurled a spear, trying to pin him to the wall.
In Babylon, the sound of this and other instruments was the signal to bow to Nebuchadnezzar's golden statue.
When the Lamb took the scroll, the twenty-four elders fell before Him, each holding one of these and golden bowls of incense.
A psalm of David promises God a new song, played on this instrument of ten strings.
In his suffering, Job said his was tuned to mourning and his flute to the sound of weeping.
